VBO:0201336.summary: Bred for loyalty, attentiveness and courage, the Tang Dog combines a lively character with watchfulness toward strangers. This southern Chinese watch and companion dog has a tradition of guarding homes and farms as well as hunting.
VBO:0201336.shortDescription: A lively southern Chinese watch and companion dog, bred for loyalty and courage, with a tradition of guarding and hunting.

sources.title: CKU — complete Tang Gou standard
sources.evidence: Actual complete standard: utilization Watch and Companion Dog; loyal, attentive, lively and brave normative ideal; historical devotion to owner, wariness of strangers and guarding homes/farms plus hunting in southern China. Full head, natural erect-ear, square compact body, four limb/paw clauses, high medium-length natural tail rolling forward over back, double coat and solid black color. Ancient thousands-of-years/dynasty explanation excluded; neither timid nor aggressive is an ideal, not a safety prediction.

sources.title: CKU — native dog conservation programme renewal (2023)
sources.evidence: Entire actual notice read: December2023 named CKU experts begin a new phase of conservation, research and promotion for registered native Chongqing, Chuandong and Tang dogs domestically and abroad. Tang expressly named alongside separate other populations; no ancestry or traits transferred. This is the most recent acquired own project statement, not proof of a2026 census or present breeder availability.
